title: Online Regime-aware Calibration for Black-box Social Simulators via Posterior-assisted Evolutionary Dynamic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2601.19481v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evolutionary dynamic optimization (EDO) commonly assumes that environmental changes can be detected from fitness variations and handled through random re-initialization, historical solutions, or learned transition patterns. Online calibration of black-box simulators introduces a different setting, where the dynamic objective is induced by sequential observations and a changing calibration window, rather than being controlled by explicit variables. Fitness variations therefore cannot be directly attributed to regime changes, while the unknown relationship between successive regimes limits conventional adaptation. We formulate this setting as an observation-driven dynamic optimization problem and propose PosEDO, which augments fitness-based EDO with an observation-conditioned parameter-space signal. translated_title: 基于后验辅助进化动态优化的黑盒社会模拟器在线状态感知校准
translated_abstract: 进化动态优化（EDO）通常假设环境变化可以通过适应度变化被检测到，并借助随机重新初始化、历史解或学习到的转换模式来处理。黑盒模拟器的在线校准引入了一种不同的设定：其动态目标由序列观测和不断变化的校准窗口所引致，而非由显式变量控制。因此，适应度变化无法直接归因于状态的改变，而相继状态之间未知的关系也限制了传统自适应方法的效果。我们将该设定形式化为一个观测驱动的动态优化问题，并提出PosEDO，该方法通过引入以观测为条件的参数空间信号来增强基于适应度的EDO。PosEDO在线学习这一信号，将其表示为从生成的参数-轨迹对中学习得到的模拟器参数后验分布……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PosEDO框架，通过在线学习模拟器参数的后验分布作为观测条件化的参数空间信号，增强传统基于适应度的进化动态优化，从而实现黑盒社会模拟器在观测驱动环境下的在线状态感知校准。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PosEDO, which augments fitness-based evolutionary dynamic optimization with an online-learned posterior distribution over simulator parameters as an observation-conditioned signal, enabling online regime-aware calibration of black-box social simulators where fitness variations cannot directly indicate regime changes.
